title: Framework-default blue as the primary colour
evidence: `.btn-primary { background: #0d6efd; border-color: #0d6efd; }` (lines 8-9) and `.navbar { background: #0d6efd; }` (line 3). #0d6efd measures oklch(0.578 0.228 260.0): inside the 255-325 arc at chroma >= 0.15 and 0.2 degrees from Tailwind blue-500 (259.8). It and its two darker shades (hue 259.8) are the only chromatic colours in the file, and nothing selected the hue. Instead: a brand hue at least 30 degrees off the default with the reason recorded, e.g. `oklch(0.58 0.11 205)` deep-cyan (54.8 degrees off) or `oklch(0.6 0.15 45)` copper.

title: Un-themed Bootstrap kit values shipped as the palette
evidence: The hover pair `#0b5ed7` / `#0a58ca` (lines 14-15) is Bootstrap 5's `.btn-primary` hover background and border verbatim, `#dee2e6` (lines 19, 23) is its gray-300 table border, and the selectors are the library's own (`.navbar`, `.btn-primary`). Nine raw colour declarations (five distinct values), no custom property anywhere. Instead: one token layer (`--primary`, `--border`) with states derived from it, `oklch(from var(--primary) calc(l - 0.05) c h)` for hover, and a rule colour tinted toward the brand hue.

title: Note text below AA contrast on white
evidence: `.note { color: #8a8a8a; font-size: 14px; }` on `background: #ffffff` measures 3.45:1 against the 4.5:1 bar for 14px text (rendered at line 24, 'Shipped to every workspace on 14 October.'). Instead: keep the neutral and lower its lightness until it clears, e.g. `#6b6b6b` (5.33:1).

title: Button label and card meta text fail AA contrast
evidence: `.btn` white 16px label on `oklch(0.68 0.14 75)` = 2.95:1 (hover `oklch(0.74 0.12 75)` = 2.34:1, line 12); `.card .meta` `#64748b` on `#0f172a` = 3.75:1 (line 15). Both are under 4.5:1. `.tag` `#6b7280` on `#f1f5f9` = 4.41:1 (line 13) misses the bar by under 0.3 and is a LOW note on its own. Instead: keep each hue and move lightness: button ground to about `oklch(0.48 0.12 75)` (6.65:1), meta to `#94a3b8` (6.96:1), tag to `#475569` (6.92:1).

title: Cream ground, serif display, sage accent and screenshot card
evidence: `background: #faf8f5` (line 8) + `font-family: 'Instrument Serif'` (line 10) + `#15573a` as headline accent and button fill (lines 15, 17), with an empty `.shot` placeholder card to the right of the hero (lines 18, 28): all three legs of the combination plus the screenshot-card hero. Nothing states it as a decision (no `anti-slop-allow`, no brand reference). Instead: anchor ground, face and accent to the product's real brand or a named reference and put the real product screenshot in the `.shot` slot; if warm editorial is the stated direction, record it with `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`.

title: Hero face outside the declared type system
evidence: `.hero { font-family: "Lobster", cursive; }` (line 13) while the DESIGN.md beside it declares one face (`fontFamily: "Söhne, system-ui, sans-serif"`; 'Söhne is the one face') and `body` on line 9 follows it. Instead: set the hero in Söhne and carry display emphasis by weight, size and tracking (`font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em`), or add the display face to DESIGN.md if it is a decision.

title: Emoji used as status dots, bullets and button icon
evidence: Seven emoji character references carry interface chrome outside prose: status dots `🟢` / `🟡` / `🔴` in the State column (lines 37-39), list bullets `✅` and `⚠️` (lines 43-45), and `🚀` inside the deploy button (line 47). Instead: keep the state encoding and move it to the system's own devices: an SVG status dot or badge in tuned status tokens beside the existing text label, check and warning icons from one icon family on the list, and a plain button label ('Deploy api again').

title: Fixed-pixel shell with no viewport meta
evidence: No `<meta name="viewport">` in the head; `.shell { width: 1200px; }` (line 15), `.lede { width: 640px; }` (line 17), `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 360px)` (line 18) and px-only type (`h1 { font-size: 48px; }`, line 16). The page overflows at every width under 1280px. Instead: add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, `width: min(100% - 2rem, 75rem)` on the shell, `max-width: 40rem` on the lede, `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(18rem, 1fr))`, and `font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 5vw, 3rem)` on the h1.

title: Middle-dot meta strings on every lane row
evidence: All three lane rows use the `A · B · C` meta string (lines 32, 36, 40: '1,382 mi · $2.41/mi · 62 loads posted'): three strings, six separator dots, at the row's concentration threshold. Instead: give the three facts their own slots, a `dl` or three aligned spans per lane (distance, rate, loads), so the rates line up down the column with `tabular-nums`.

title: Flat-terminal subtraction-only system
evidence: Code-only token reading: `--panel: oklch(0.13 0.003 270)` on `--ground: oklch(0.12 0.003 270)` is a 1.01:1 tint step; the only boundary is `--hair: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08)`, 1.16:1 against ground and panel (edge floor 1.3:1); no shadow or rim; `--accent: oklch(0.6 0.02 270)` has chroma 0.02 (floor 0.10) and appears only as current-nav text; the only chromatic colour is status (`--ok`, `--bad`); `system-ui` at 400/600 with no display face. S3 and S4 fail together with S1 and S2. Instead, adding rather than removing: a ground derived from a brand hue, three measured surface levels with a top-edge rim on panels (`box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 ...`) and a border that measures 1.3:1, a brand accent at chroma 0.12 or more used as a fill on the current nav item and one key figure, and explicit heading weight and tracking.

title: Focus ring bound to :focus, not :focus-visible
evidence: Both buttons carry `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-600 focus:ring-offset-2` (lines 31, 34) with no `focus-visible:` variant, so a mouse click and keyboard focus draw the same ring. Instead: `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2`; the ring stays and moves to keyboard focus.

title: Frosted-glass sticky navigation bar
evidence: `<nav class="backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 border-b sticky top-0">`: translucent white, backdrop blur, hairline and sticky together, the frosted-nav signature (aliases: Strongest-10 #2, section 11). Instead: a solid nav on a raised surface with a brand tint, or a static header; keep blur only where type must stay legible over moving content.

title: Purple neon glow on the CTA
evidence: `.cta { box-shadow: 0 0 40px 6px rgba(168,85,247,.6); }`: a 40px-blur, 6px-spread halo in purple-500 (hue 303.9, inside the C3 arc) on a light page with no dark-mode need. title: Focus outline removed with no replacement
evidence: `a:focus, button:focus { outline: none; }` with no `:focus-visible` rule anywhere in the stylesheet, so the 'Open the firing schedule' button and every link lose their keyboard focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7). title: Neutral gray text on a saturated blue surface

title: Verbatim Tailwind hero type triplet
evidence: `<h1 class="text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight">`: the unmodified Tailwind hero run, all five classes in order (aliases: T14, P2), with zero `clamp()` in the file. title: Camera product page with no imagery
evidence: A product page for a camera, a visual product, with 0 `img` / `picture` / `figure` / `video` / `canvas` across the header and all 4 sections; every section is three bordered cards of a 22px stroke glyph, an h3 and a line of copy (12 icon cards, lines 35-52; aliases: L4, L5, substance check S6). title: Icon-only remove button has no accessible name
evidence: `<button class="remove" type="button"><svg ...>...</svg></button>`: the only child is an SVG, with no `aria-label`, no visually hidden text and no `<title>` (WCAG 4.1.2), so a screen reader announces only 'button'. Instead: `<button class="remove" type="button" aria-label="Delete draft: Re: bench slot for the tenor sax">` with `aria-hidden="true"` on the svg.

title: Cream ground with a serif display face
evidence: `body { background: #faf8f5; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; }`: the generated cream hex plus a serif display face, two legs of the combination, with nothing stating it as a decision. Instead: anchor ground and face to the product's real brand or a named reference, or record the warm-editorial direction with `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`.

Transform your workflow. Effortlessly.

title: shadcn demo revenue stat shipped verbatim
evidence: `$45,231.89` with `+20.1% from last month` under 'Total revenue' (lines 22-24): the shadcn dashboard demo stat, value and delta both verbatim. Instead: the product's real figure with real comparison context (against target or the previous sync).

title: Generic 'Welcome back!' greeting as hero subtext
evidence: `Welcome back! Pick up where the last sync left off.` is the hero's only subtext: a generic greeting where recognition should be data. Instead: something only this user would see, e.g. 'Last sync finished 40 minutes ago, 3 records need review'.

title: Infinite logo marquee with no pause control
evidence: `.track { animation: scroll 30s linear infinite; }` with `@keyframes scroll { to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }` over a duplicated logo row (lines 11-17, 24-29): an infinite sideways loop with no pause button, hover pause or focus pause (WCAG 2.2.2; alias: L8). title: Refresh button wired to a TODO comment
evidence: `<button onclick="/* TODO: wire refresh */">Refresh</button>`: the handler is a comment, so the control does nothing. Instead: wire it to the invoice fetch with a busy state (`aria-busy` and 'Refreshing invoices...'), or show a 'Last updated' timestamp in its place until refresh exists.

title: Invoice table ships the happy path only
evidence: The invoice table (lines 20-29) exists only populated: three rows, all `Paid`. There is no empty state, no loading or error branch for the fetch the Refresh button implies, and `.status.paid` (line 11) is the only status style, with no overdue or unpaid treatment. Instead: design the empty state first ('No invoices yet' with the first action), an inline error row with retry, a loading state that matches the table layout, and status variants that pair colour with a label or icon.

title: Monospace on human-readable stat readouts
evidence: `--font-mono: "JetBrains Mono"` is applied to human-readable readouts: `talent-level-value` (line 7), `talent-level-preset` buttons (9), `talent-tree-points` (11), `talent-points-spent` (13), `talent-node-rank` (15) and `talent-table td.num` (17), each of which already sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Instead: `font-family: var(--font-sans)` on the six readouts, keeping `tabular-nums` for digit alignment and `--font-weight-emphasis` plus colour for hierarchy.

title: Bounce motion on a status confirmation and menu
evidence: `@keyframes bounce-in` reverses direction three times (0, -24px, 0, -10px, 0; lines 18-24) on a `role="status"` order confirmation; `.menu` uses `cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)`, which both anticipates and overshoots (line 16); the cue arrow carries `animate-bounce` (line 35). Instead: one settle per arrival: a 200-250ms ease-out rise for the toast (`translateY(8px)` to 0 with opacity), a 150-200ms ease-out for the menu, and a static cue; keep the reduced-motion gate.

title: Three paragraphs dropped between the tiles and the table
evidence: Measurement: 3 orphan paragraphs (27, 63 and 24 words; the longest is over the 60-word bar) at lines 34-36, direct children of `main`, between the `ul.tiles` stat grid and the invoice `table` with no heading over them. Instead: the refresh note becomes the tiles' caption ('Updated hourly from the ledger'), and the collections and credits explanations move into the headed sections below the table or behind a `details` whose summary names them.

title: Three consecutive text-only sections
evidence: Measurement: 3 consecutive text-only sections (lines 45-55: 'How balances are calculated', 'Payment terms', 'Who to contact'), each an h2 and two paragraphs with no list, table, control or figure, on a billing control surface. Instead: a non-text device in at least every second section: payment terms as a small table (standard, enterprise, late fees), contacts as a `dl` with linked inboxes; no added prose.

title: Grid, dot and stripe patterns behind content
evidence: Three decorative patterns behind content: a 24px hairline grid on `body::before` (two 1px linear-gradients at right angles, lines 13-14), a 1px dot field on a 16px tile behind `.hero` (line 18), and 8px 45-degree stripes behind `.promo` (line 19). Instead: a solid ground with one tone shift between the hero and the promo strip; keep a grid only where it carries meaning.

title: Gradient text on one hero word
evidence: `.accent { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.62 0.15 25), oklch(0.72 0.16 60)); background-clip: text; color: transparent; }` (lines 17-22) applied to the single word 'reconciled' in the h1 (line 28), with no `anti-slop-allow` stating it as a brand decision (alias: T15 single accented word). Instead: carry the emphasis across the whole line in one ink (a weight or size step), or record the gradient as a brand device with `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`.

title: 281 words of prose above the drop table
evidence: Measurement: 281 words of running prose above the primary element (the 'Drop sources' table, line 47) against the 40-word reference-page budget: a 27-word lede in the identity block plus four paragraphs of 75, 63, 60 and 56 words under 'About the Thornfang Blade' (lines 40-43). Instead: identity block, then the table; move the four paragraphs below it under headed sections ('How the figures are computed', 'Drop-rate caveats', 'Enchant history') or behind a `details` whose summary names its content. No fact is deleted.

title: Saturated radial halo behind the hero
evidence: `.hero { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.8), transparent 70%); }` on a `#0b0b10` page: a saturated cyan halo at 0.8 alpha fading to transparent behind the hero, the CSS form of the blur blob (headline contrast over it cannot be measured statically). Instead: a solid brand block or atmosphere under 0.05, with the rota itself as the focal content.

title: Reading mechanics set against the reader
evidence: Four rules: `.hero h1 { font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: -0.1em; }` (line 10; the floor is -0.07em under 40px, so letters collide); `.article p { line-height: 1.15; }` at 16px (line 11; floor 1.3); `.note p { letter-spacing: 0.12em; }` on mixed-case prose (line 12; ceiling 0.05em); `.sidebar-note { width: 22ch; text-align: justify; }` with no `hyphens: auto` (line 13). Instead: h1 at `-0.02em`, body `line-height: 1.5`, note tracking `0`, and ragged-right (`text-align: start`) in the 22ch aside.

title: Unmodified shadcn Card class run
evidence: `<div class="rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the shadcn `Card` primitive's class run verbatim (pre-v4 radius), demo `p-6` included. Instead: keep the frame and tune it: a stated radius token, a border colour measured against both surfaces, an elevation step chosen for this panel's role, and padding from the product's density.

title: Border, shadow-sm and radius trio on every card
evidence: `shadow-sm hover:shadow-md border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4` (line 10) repeats the border + `shadow-sm` + radius trio already on the card at line 6, so both cards on the surface carry the same unexamined treatment (aliases: C12, D3). Instead: commit the trio by role: one radius the system states, a resting panel with a measured edge and no shadow, and a raised step reserved for the card that sits above.

title: shadcn init token block shipped untouched
evidence: The `:root` block (lines 8-20) is the current `shadcn init` neutral scaffold verbatim: `--radius: 0.625rem`, `--background: oklch(1 0 0)`, `--foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0)`, `--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0)`, `--border: oklch(0.922 0 0)`, `--ring: oklch(0.708 0 0)`; every token has chroma 0. The OKLCH notation is the generator's, not a tuned theme. Instead: make the first hue decision, e.g. `--primary: oklch(0.58 0.16 40)`, derive hover, soft and border states with relative colour syntax, set an off-white ground (`oklch(0.985 0.005 90)`) and state a radius identity.

title: Unmodified shadcn Card on the seats panel
evidence: `<div class="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the unmodified shadcn `Card` class run with the demo `p-6`, a separate span from the token block. title: Coloured side stripe on every note
evidence: Five coloured side stripes in five syntaxes: `.tip { border-left: 4px solid oklch(0.52 0.1 180); }` (line 11), `.quote { border-inline-start: 3px solid ...; }` (12), `.feature::before { width: 4px; ... }` (14), `.panel { box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 ...; }` (15) and `rounded-xl border-l-4 border-teal-600` (25); none marks selection, an alert role or a category (alias: V2). evidence: `::view-transition-old(root), ::view-transition-new(root) { animation-duration: 650ms; }` runs on every navigation between the three route pages; the page-transition budget is 200-400ms. Instead: `animation-duration: 220ms` with an ease-out curve, keeping the `no-preference` gate.

title: Hardcoded values beside the defined tokens
evidence: Tokens are defined (`--brand: oklch(0.49 0.085 158)`, `--space-100/200/300` = 4/8/12px, `--radius: 6px`) and bypassed in the same file: `.save { background: oklch(0.543 0.104 159); padding: 11px 17px; border-radius: 5px; }` (lines 24-27), hover `oklch(0.5 0.11 160)` (30), `.hint { margin-top: 9px; font-size: 13px; }` (31) and a raw border `oklch(0.918 0.003 107)` (19): two raw greens a few points off `--brand`, and 11px, 17px, 9px and 5px lengths off the 4-8-12 scale and the 6px radius. title: Running text and links under the size floors
evidence: `.article p { font-size: 11px; }` on the running renewal paragraph (floor 12px; rendered at line 21); `.footer-nav a { font-size: 10px; }` on links (functional floor 11px; line 12); `.price-note { font-size: 0.625rem; }` = 10px inline in body copy (line 11). title: 8px radius on every control

title: rounded-full on every control including the textarea

Instead: a radius language varied by control class: pill on the tag and the button if pill is the identity, and a `--r-field` token (6px or less) on input, select and textarea.

title: 100vh shell with a bottom bar and no safe-area inset
evidence: `.app { height: 100vh; }` (line 16) with `.bar { position: fixed; bottom: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; }` (lines 21-22), no `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`, and no `viewport-fit=cover` in the viewport meta. title: Viewport media query lays out a two-width component

title: Viewport meta disables zoom
evidence: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no">`: pinch zoom is disabled (WCAG 1.4.4). Instead: `content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"`.

title: Positive tabindex reorders the search form
evidence: Positive tabindex on all four form controls: `tabindex="3"` on the search field (line 18), `1` and `2` on the date fields (21, 24) and `4` on the submit button (26). Keyboard order becomes Issued after, Issued before, search, submit, against the visual order and ahead of the header link. Instead: remove the attributes and let DOM order drive focus; reorder the markup if a different order is wanted.
